card.name: Possessive words before balance sheet
card.fires_on: Possessive words like banks, its, their, my, his, or 'the' right before 'balance sheet' or cash flow in accounting talk. It also fires on words leading into financial statement terms.

modes.label: Possessive before balance sheet
modes.description: A possessive word (banks, its, their, my) just before 'balance sheet' in a discussion of who records an asset.
modes.example: Therefore the bank should not record my cash on<< its>> balance sheet as an asset, even if

modes.label: Lead-in to financial statements
modes.description: A linking word before cash flow or financial statement terms in accounting or finance text.
modes.example: Calculating Cash flow from Operations Here are<< the>> steps for calculating the cash flow from operations

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward financial and balance (as in balance sheet).
card.plain: It spots the spot just before words like 'balance sheet' or 'financial' in accounting text.
